1. **Keep compatibility suppressions declaration-scoped** When a newly enabled rule flags an established union representation, the PR demonstrates adding a targeted suppression beside that declaration with a reason; it does not globally disable the rule or change the contract. Reassess the declaration rather than applying this as a blanket exemption. *Scope:* TypeSpec rule migrations affecting existing unions and SDK contracts *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/47140, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/2c38e623d7a77d6c9fcdd89e322e655fe23cbebd/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/sdk-java-azure-ai-agents/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/2c38e623d7a77d6c9fcdd89e322e655fe23cbebd/specification/batch/resource-manager/Microsoft.Batch/Batch/client.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/2c38e623d7a77d6c9fcdd89e322e655fe23cbebd/specification/containerregistry/resource-manager/Microsoft.ContainerRegistry/Registry/client.tsp

2. **Keep dependency pins and generated output aligned** This dependency-update PR changed the workspace catalog and lockfile, and refreshed generated Foundry output for the new emitters. Treat generation as a compatibility check for the updated toolchain, not as evidence that service API versions or contracts changed. *Scope:* Repository-wide TypeSpec dependency and generated-artifact updates *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/47140, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/2c38e623d7a77d6c9fcdd89e322e655fe23cbebd/pnpm-workspace.yaml

Another bot comment reports failed checks, and a commenter attributes a Go failure to unrelated go fmt; the supplied evidence does not establish how those reports were resolved. No tests were run for this extraction.
- Suppressions concern varied union contracts, including API unions, SDK-specific representations, and extensible unions. Do not generalize them into a requirement to suppress every union warning or to change discriminator, alias/model, inheritance, default, naming, or duration representations.
